name: Run golangci-lint
description: Official golangci-lint action with line-attached annotations for found issues, caching and parallel execution.

version.description:
The version of golangci-lint to use.
When `install-mode` is `binary` (default) the value can be v1.2 or v1.2.3 or `latest` to use the latest version.
When `inst

working-directory.description: golangci-lint working directory, default is project root

github-token.description: the token is used for fetching patch of a pull request to show only new issues

only-new-issues.description: if set to true and the action runs on a pull request - the action outputs only newly found issues

skip-cache.description:
if set to true then the all caching functionality will be complete disabled,
takes precedence over all other caching options.

skip-pkg-cache.description: if set to true then the action doesn't cache or restore ~/go/pkg.

skip-build-cache.description: if set to true then the action doesn't cache or restore ~/.cache/go-build.

install-mode.description: The mode to install golangci-lint. It can be 'binary' or 'goinstall'.
